meta.description: How Global Strategic Technologies collects, uses, and safeguards your information when you visit our website or engage with our advisory services.
title: Privacy Policy
intro: Global Strategic Technologies LLC ("GST," "we," "us," or "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard information when you visit our website or engage with our services.
collect.heading: Information We Collect
collect.lead: We may collect the following types of information:
collect.item1: Contact Information: Name, email address, phone number, and company details you provide when contacting us or scheduling consultations.
collect.item2: Usage Data: Information about how you interact with our website, including IP address, browser type, pages visited, and time spent on pages.
collect.item3: Communications: Records of correspondence when you contact us via email, phone, or through our website.
use.heading: How We Use Your Information
use.lead: We use the information we collect to:
use.item1: Respond to your inquiries and provide requested services
use.item3: Improve our website and service offerings
use.item4: Send occasional updates about our services (you may opt out at any time)
sharing.heading: Information Sharing
sharing.lead: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. We may share your information only in the following circumstances:
sharing.item1: Service Providers: With trusted third-party service providers who assist in operating our website or conducting our business (e.g., calendar scheduling tools, email services).
sharing.item2: Legal Requirements: When required by law or to protect our rights, property, or safety.
sharing.item3: Business Transfers: In connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets.
thirdParty.heading: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.lead: Our website may use third-party services such as:
thirdParty.item2: Analytics Tools: To understand website usage patterns
thirdParty.note: These services have their own privacy policies, and we encourage you to review them.
cookies.heading: Cookies and Tracking
cookies.body: Our website may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings.
security.heading: Data Security
security.body: We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
rights.heading: Your Rights
rights.item1: Access the personal information we hold about you
rights.item3: Request deletion of your information (subject to legal obligations)
confidentiality.heading: Client Confidentiality
confidentiality.body: For information shared during client engagements, we maintain strict confidentiality in accordance with our engagement agreements and professional standards. Client project information is handled separately from general website visitor data.
children.heading: Children's Privacy
children.body: Our services are not directed to individuals under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
changes.heading: Changes to This Policy
changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Last Updated" date. We encourage you to review this policy regularly.
california.heading: California Privacy Rights
california.body: California residents have additional rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), including the right to know what personal information is collected, the right to delete personal information, and the right to opt out of the sale of personal information. We do not sell personal information.
contact.heading: Contact Us
contact.lead: If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:
